name: Target Shooter VR
summary: Get ready for a barnyard blast in Target Shooter VR, the latest creation from Circle Beard Studio! Step into a vibrant farm setting where your shooting skills are put to the ultimate test. Targets spawn randomly around you, but they’re not just any targets – they’re chickens, ducks, pigs, and cows, making every shot a thrilling challenge. Armed with a VR blaster, you’ll need precision and quick reflexes to hit your mark and rack up high scores. Target Shooter VR offers a fun and frenetic experience for play
